description: Continuously test agents across a matrix of models, prompts, tools, and environments — and block rollouts on regressions.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; app.js was rewritten cleanly against the real shared/kit.js contract after a patch-script brace accident.

notes.note: 'Ship or stop' across model versions is a real, felt pain for agent teams, and CI-style pricing is legible. Weakest assumption: it stays standalone — every eval/observability incumbent will ship 'regression across model versions' as a tab within a year. Survives only if it becomes the neutral third party all platforms trust.
Matrix run fills all 12 cells with scores; cell detail works; zero errors.

notes.change: Rollout gate is now real state: 'Block rollout'/'File ticket' set a persistent BLOCKED gate (localStorage) with a re-open toggle and ticket list, replacing toast-only actions.
